Selected projects

Personal Loan Application

How I redesigned PicPay's personal loan application experience — cutting the journey from 9 to 5 screens, reducing friction and boosting conversion by 50% on launch day.

Scaling the design foundation for Loans

How I architected a local component library and template system for PicPay's Loans Business Unit — reducing design fragmentation and accelerating handoffs.

Same-Day Loan Cancellation

Change Payment Due Date

Designing the logic and content for letting Personal Loan customers move their installment due date — across every loan status, from current to refinanced.

About me

Designing with purpose, building with care.

I'm a Senior Product Designer with 6 years of dedicated experience in a major Finance environment, specializing in large-scale credit and loan products. I work at PicPay — one of the largest digital banks in Brazil — where I've been responsible for all unsecured loan products: Personal Loans, Salary-linked Loans, Contract Addendums, and Buy Now Pay Later.

I have a strong foundation in Computer Engineering and Systems Analysis, which enables effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and measurable business impact.
